headlines.headline: KINGS WAIVE SIX-TIME ALL-STAR DEMAR DEROZAN, INSTANTLY ONE OF THE TOP NAMES LEFT IN FREE AGENCY
headlines.detail: Sacramento waived DeMar DeRozan, making the six-time All-Star an unrestricted free agent; the Wizards have already opened talks with him. The Clippers-Raptors trade sending Kawhi Leonard back to Toronto remains on hold pending the NBA's investigation.

headlines.headline: PRESEASON KICKS OFF AS RUNNING BACK MARKET RESETS WITH BIJAN ROBINSON, JAHMYR GIBBS, JONATHAN TAYLOR EXTENSIONS
headlines.detail: The Panthers and Cardinals played the league's first live preseason snaps of 2026 following Thursday's Hall of Fame Game, while a run of extensions for top backs reset the position's pay scale.

headlines.headline: PROPOSED COLLEGE SPORTS BILL AMENDMENT COULD TRIGGER A NEW WAVE OF CONFERENCE REALIGNMENT
headlines.detail: A proposed amendment to a pending college sports bill in Congress could reopen conference realignment ahead of the 2026 season kicking off Aug. 29. Preseason All-America teams were also released this week.

headlines.headline: NCAA WARNS COACHES OF MID-SEASON SUSPENSIONS AS ELIGIBILITY LAWSUITS RESHAPE THE TRANSFER PORTAL
headlines.detail: Gonzaga added Florida State transfer Chauncey Wiggins, and Houston landed Texas transfer Chendall Weaver after a Tennessee judge ruled him eligible for a fifth season.
